description: This file is a Java Spring MVC controller class named ContractController. It handles web requests related to creating, accepting, and printing contracts within the application. It interacts with service classes for business logic and manages contract-related HTTP endpoints.

classes.name: ContractController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller managing contract-related web endpoints, including creation, acceptance, and printing of contracts.

methods.name: newContract
methods.description: Handles GET request to show the form for creating a new contract for a specified client ID.

methods.name: registerUser
methods.description: Handles POST request to register and save a new contract, including validation and logic to decide if the contract is accepted or sent for supervisor approval.

methods.name: acceptContract
methods.description: Handles GET request to accept a contract if the authenticated user is authorized.

methods.name: printContract
methods.description: Handles GET request to print the contract if it has been accepted, handling file not found exceptions.
